﻿﻿Adds a seasonal, brewery building to age casks in.
Process your kegs 15% faster inside of the building! (20% and 25% faster in the upgrades)
Features two additional upgrades for more space and faster processing. 

Pair it with: [b]HxW Winery Furniture [/b]for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32162]decorations [/url]﻿[/b]matching the building.

[b][size=6][quote]IMPORTANT UPDATE INFORMATION FOR VERSION 1.2[/quote][/size][/b]The code had to be overhauled for our buildings because to be honest, we ended up with so many that it was getting quite messy in there and hard to find bugs and things. Because of this, the internal IDs of nearly all of the buildings have changed and therefore the game will [i]not[/i] recognize your buildings from the previous version of the mod. For a new save, or a save where you have not built any of our buildings yet, this is fine and you can just install and enjoy! However, if you have existing buildings PLEASE READ ON to avoid errors when updating.

[b][color=#f6b26b]IMPORTANT NOTE --> YOU MUST FOLLOW THESE DIRECTIONS BEFORE UPDATING THE BUILDINGS MOD IF YOU HAVE AN EXISTING SAVE[/color][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Load your existing save and empty out any existing HXW Buildings you have of all contents. Store it all wherever you want just NOT IN THE BUILDING.
[*]Visit Robin and demolish these buildings. Sorry but they have to be gone before you update the mod.
[*]Save the game and exit. 
[*]Delete the old version of the mod and cleanly install the new version. 
[*]If you wish to give yourself enough $ to re-purchase the buildings you had to demolish, use a mod like CJB Cheats that will allow you to do so.
[*]Run the game and check the configurations in Generic Mod Config Menu to make sure it looks correct.
[*]Give yourself the money you need and visit Robin and rebuild the buildings you had to demolish.
[/list]
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][font=Georgia][size=3][font=Georgia][color=#f6b26b][size=3][i]We know this is a bit of a headache now but trust us, this was a band-aid that had to come off so we appreciate your understanding![/i][/size][/color][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font]

[b]🍇﻿[size=4] [/size][size=3]How to obtain:[/size][/b]
-If the config is set to "Shed": Purchase a normal (basic) shed at the Carpenter.
- Once the basic shed is built, you will find the Bakery-Style  shed as a buildable upgrade.
-If the config is set to "Building": It is a new building immediately available at the Carpenter.

Shed version is specifically available for those who want to use this with Market Town. It is NOT compatible with other custom shed mods. If you want to be able to use other custom shed maps, you must use the "Building" version of this mod. 

[size=3]🍇﻿[size=4] [/size]  HxW Furniture to Decorate your brewery:[/size]
Check out the catalogue
with all of our furniture: [url=https://himetarts.wixsite.com/artsite/services-9]H&W Catalogue


[size=3]🍇[/size][/url] [size=3]Compatibility:[/size]
Yes it is compatible with SVE and all additional expansions.
It is compatible with custom sheds and other custom buildings.
